description: Add a reply to a feedback item's thread in layernote so the team can follow along: what was changed, why, a question for the reviewer, or that a fix is waiting on a deploy. The reply appears in the item's thread under the name of the person who created the token.

project.description: The project, by name or id from list_projects. Only needed when the token reaches several projects

name: add_feedback_comment
title: Reply to a feedback item
